wiki.title: David Brock Smith
wiki.extract: David Brock Smith (born 1976/1977) is an American Republican politician currently serving in the Oregon State Senate. He represents the 1st district, which covers all of Curry County and parts of Coos and Douglas counties. He is the Republican nominee in the 2026 U.S. Senate election in Oregon.
